translation.title: Analgesic and Anti-inflammatory Cataplasm (Pap)
translation.efficacy: This medicine is used for the analgesic and anti-inflammatory relief of sprains, bruises, muscle pain, joint pain, pain from fractures, low back pain, stiff shoulders, and chilblains.
translation.usage: Peel off the polyester film from the medicated surface and apply the patch to the affected area once or twice a day.
translation.caution: Consult a doctor or pharmacist before using this medicine in the following cases: people who have experienced an allergic reaction (such as rash, redness (congestion and reddening), itching or dermatitis caused by lacquer); people with an allergic constitution; moist skin or erosion; people who are under treatment by a doctor. Do not use this medicine in the following cases: eczema; dermatitis caused by lacquer or the like; wounded areas. If your symptoms do not improve after 5 to 6 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and directions. When it is used by a child, use it under the supervision of a guardian. This medicine is for external use only. Stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist if any of the following occur: rash and redness (congestion and reddening); itching. Store at room temperature, protected from moisture and light. Keep out of reach of children.
